chars.story: The mouth jerks with a catch in the throat: a hiccup.
A mouth tacking on a shrug at the end of a sentence.
chars.note: Spoken-style sentence ending. 唄 became 呗.

chars.story: A mouth crying out in surprise: oh!
chars.note: An interjection. Written as 哟 too.

chars.story: A mouth grumbling under its breath: mutter.
A mouth letting out a long high cry: a screech.
Many mouths at once: uproar.
A mouth announcing loudly: noisy.
chars.note: Written 'noisy': 喧闹, 喧哗; 吵 is the everyday word.

chars.story: A mouth forced wide open: shout.
The long cry of a horse: a neigh.
The passage behind the mouth that food goes down.
chars.note: Also 'to swallow', as in 吞咽.

chars.story: A mouth that bites and swallows: devour.
A mouth that keeps asking for more: addicted.
A mouth barking out a rough breath: a cough.
chars.note: Only in 咳嗽, with 咳.

chars.story: A mouth cutting on and on: garrulous.
A mouth working away at a long chat.

groups.title: old particles
groups.note: Words from older writing that still end sentences.

chars.story: Like an arrow that has landed: the thing is done.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'now / has become'. In modern prose it appears only in set phrases. Classical counterpart of 了.

chars.story: A mouth crying out in feeling: how!
chars.note: Old exclamation, now only in fixed phrases.

chars.story: A person weighing what might happen: if.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: wipe, cover, pick.

chars.story: A hand picking out one piece: single out.
A hand drawn across a surface: wipe.
A hand clamped over something.
A hand flicking something away: fling aside.
chars.note: Also the left-falling stroke 丿 in writing.

chars.story: A hand dipping into a bowl: ladle.

groups.title: heart 忄
groups.note: A heart on the left: feelings.

chars.story: A heart that needs shelter at the first scare: cowardly.
A heart open and easy: generous.
A heart suddenly seeing a bright scene.
A heart leaning toward something, like a child.
A heart that sighs over what has gone: sigh with regret.
A heart at ease: harmony.

groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: A speech mark on the left: orders, taboos, blame.

chars.story: Words that summon the whole land: an imperial edict.
Words you must not say: taboo.
Words saying someone is not what he is: slander.

chars.parts: 讠 words + 戒 guard against
chars.story: Words telling you what to guard against: a commandment.
A sentence pronounced in words and in red: put to death.

groups.title: silk 纟
groups.note: Thread on the left: twist, pull, stretch.

chars.story: Strands crossed over and over, squeezed tight: wring.
Thread tying things down calmly: pacify.
chars.note: 綏 became 绥. Almost only in 绥靖 'appeasement' and place names.

chars.story: Thread pulled tight: taut.
A seam splitting open: burst open.

chars.parts: ⺮ bamboo + 目 eye + 糸 thread
chars.story: Bamboo slips threaded together: compile a book.
The old curving script cut onto seals.
The stone you look into for black ink.
The first half of the lemon tree.
chars.note: Only in 柠檬. 檸 became 柠.

chars.story: The second half of the lemon tree.

chars.parts: - a thorny tree with two tiers of spines
chars.story: A thorny tree whose red fruit we call dates.
A wooden stick as tall as a man: a staff.
The broad-leaved tree whose seeds make oil.

groups.title: plants 艹
groups.note: Grass on top: herbs, flowers, fungus.

chars.story: A young bamboo pushing out of the ground.
Plant matter mashed smooth: a bean paste.
A small white flower: jasmine.
A herb with a curling seed: fennel.
Grass growing at the water's edge: cattail.
A plant that pops up wild on the damp ground.
Not grass alone: food with meat.

groups.title: more grass 艹
groups.note: Other characters with grass on top.

chars.story: A grassy area curled round by a wall: a park.
Dipping a bundle of grass in liquid.
The gas that smothers flame: nitrogen.
The soft metal hidden inside salt: sodium.
The third of the ten heavenly stems, also the 'prop' in propane.
chars.note: Used as a number, like A-B-C, and in chemistry.

chars.story: The insect that leaves a pattern of bites.

chars.parts: 尸 body + 辛 bitter + 牛 ox
chars.story: A heavy bitter-tempered ox-like beast.
The blade that steers a fish: a fin.
A horse startled and rearing: astonish.
A deer-like creature of legend: the qilin.
chars.note: Mostly in 麒麟 and set phrases.

chars.story: Skin folded into lines: wrinkled.
The mark left where a wound stuck: a scab.
Clothes lined thick against winter.
Rough cloth of earthy colour: dark brown.
A white cake that cleans: soap.
One swinging side of a door.
A lean-to with a door: a hut.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 爿 bed + 又 hand
chars.story: A bed under a roof: a bedroom.
A high-roofed covered carriage, later a pavilion.
chars.note: 軒 became 轩. A lighter, airier pavilion than 阁; mostly in names.

chars.story: Cloth hung over an opening: a window curtain.

groups.title: cutting
groups.note: Blades that chop, cut and shave.

chars.story: A tool with an axe-head on a handle.

chars.parts: - a tool striking into a pit
chars.story: A chisel biting into a hole in the rock.
chars.note: 鑿 became 凿. The picture is a stack of strokes; learn it whole.

chars.story: A knife drawn over the head: shave.
A person from the tiled hill villages of the far southwest: the Wa.
chars.note: Only in the name of this people of Yunnan and Burma.

chars.story: A river in Fujian.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 辛 bitter + 𠂤 mound
chars.story: A family name.
chars.note: A surname. The parts are old and hard to read.

chars.story: A walking shape used in Buddhist names.
Steps that lose and take turns: alternately.
Feet measuring a floor: pace.
A bald head hanging down: sunk and decadent.
Metal that will not cut: blunt.
Rain floods the hut and the ink runs: the writing is a sloppy mess.
Water so clear it looks deep.
Rain-like murk hanging in the air: haze.

chars.parts: 猋 three dogs + 风 wind
chars.story: Three dogs running before the wind: a gale.
A blessing at the altar: joy.
chars.note: A name element, as in the Empress Dowager 慈禧.

chars.story: The curve of a drawn bow: an arc.
Bare bone, ill omen: wicked.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'bare bones'. In modern prose it means 'bad', as in 歹徒.

chars.story: Two tens joined: twenty.
chars.note: Meet it in dates and old texts.

chars.parts: - a figure raised by hands over a pit
chars.story: A figure lifted by two hands: a helper, a deputy.
chars.note: Old official title. An old title for a deputy, as in 丞相 'chancellor'.

chars.story: A sprout just showing above a field: just now.
chars.note: Also a poet's name, 杜甫.

chars.parts: - a one and a bending figure
chars.story: A figure bent over under one stroke: a beggar.
chars.note: Meet it mainly in 乞丐.

chars.story: A fire laid to rest: put out.
Standing up from a finished job: it is completed.
Strong force brought against an official: impeach.

chars.parts: 尸 body + 羴 three sheep
chars.story: A flock of sheep jostled together: mix.
A vulgar word for what hangs from the body.
chars.note: A crude word that appears in internet slang.

sentences.en: The candle went out by itself.
He hid himself behind the curtain.
Don't chatter! I have to study.
